The excerpt relies entirely on exteriority and completely lacks interiority. The text focuses exclusively on observable actions (loading the wagon, driving the horses away, walking back into the house), spoken dialogue, and detailed physical descriptions of the setting (the village, the road, and the layout of the hallway). At no point does the narrator provide insight into the characters' inner lives, thoughts, feelings, or memories.
